title: Check opaque FPGA IP clock connectivity after mixed RTL/netlist integration
observed_problem: Full optimized resource probe mapped and met setup at 50MHz but had 18 DSP cascade hold violations. PAR showed an extra fabric-routed local clk_IBUF network with 305 loads beside the inferred BUFG.
initial_assumption: A BUFG inferred for visible soft RTL would necessarily clock the opaque linked FFT NGC as well.
observable_consequence: The IP DSP cascade path had 0.508ns data delay and 0.589ns positive clock skew, yielding -0.081ns hold slack. Standalone IP timing had not exposed the integration clock split.
assessed_root_cause: Mixed inferred-clock RTL and opaque NGC integration left the IP branch on the raw input clock net; verified in PAR clock reports.
corrective_method: Use one explicit top-level BUFG shared by all soft logic and opaque FFT IP. Retain the 20ns constraint and reject timing exception workarounds.
alternatives_and_negative_results: Local-clock version: minimum period 19.417ns but 18 hold failures; not accepted.
No false-path, multicycle, or clock-period relaxation was used.
repeatable_validation: Recreate grouping_ram_pipelined and grouping_ram_globalclock with prepare_resource_probes.py and run MAP/PAR/TRCE; inspect clock reports. Final probe: clk_g global only, 1213 loads, min period 19.260ns, setup/hold failures zero.
generalizable_lesson: Standalone IP timing success and a visible top BUFG do not prove that every linked IP clock endpoint uses that BUFG. Inspect post-link/post-route clock networks and include hold checks.
applicability: Mixed soft RTL and opaque IP/netlist synthesis flows, especially inferred clock-buffer insertion.
nonapplicability: Not a claim that all cores require manually instantiated BUFGs; explicit clock architecture and actual tool reports govern. Does not justify unsupported timing exceptions.
safety_and_contract_constraints: No production RTL or bitstream change; no stage advance; no change to C02 arithmetic, requirements, existing acceptance or prior lessons.
reviewer_role: Pending engineer review; no independent human review claimed
time_provenance: Current experiment recording time; not historical reconstruction
